Money doesn't grow on trees. We were born on the wrong side of the tracks. We're workers. Rich people are miserable.

Kevin Trudeau calls these counter intentions - beliefs handed down through a family until they feel like facts.

You can be working hard on making money while one of them quietly sabotages every effort, because underneath, it says you shouldn't have it.

His point: until you clear it out, the struggle keeps coming back no matter how hard you work.

Which of these did you grow up hearing?

#kevintrudeau #moneybeliefs #mindset #generationalwealth #wealthmindset #subconsciousmind

You tried to make money once and it failed. The embarrassment, the people who laughed - it stung.

Kevin Trudeau says your mind files that away the same way it filed the first time you touched a hot stove: trying to make money leads to pain.

From then on, part of you works against you. You hesitate, you pick the wrong move, you do something careless - and nobody sees why.

It also happens to people who made money and then lost it all.

What failure is still running your money decisions?

#kevintrudeau #failure #selfsabotage #moneymindset #mindset #entrepreneur

Kevin Trudeau started his first business with $100 he'd saved from shoveling snow and delivering newspapers. Direct mail, from his house.

It was a struggle. Ads that should have worked didn't. It felt like walking uphill with something pushing back.

His mentor helped him clear one belief that was working against him. He went back to the same business, changed one word in one headline - and the money started pouring in.

He made over a million dollars before he turned 18.

What would change if your work stopped feeling like a struggle?
